programs.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programs.desc: The Scrappers are just over halfway to their target but bleeding money; the Gold Gypsies are desperate to find their final 30 ounces; the Mahoneys return to their 8-Mile lease earlier in the season.

programs.title: Adventure Gold Diggers
programs.desc: The Clermont Diggers are under pressure to repay $15,000 worth of gold to their investor or they risk losing their mine. The Mineshaft Hunters enter a dangerous abandoned gold mine with hopes of hitting the motherload. Gold snipers Levi and Rob battle the Tasmanian wilderness to get to a secret river system they've nicknamed The Honey Hole.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: After a successful deer hunt, Tom rushes to prepare the meat before it attracts hungry grizzly bears. Marty's mechanical problems return and leave him stranded in the cold Alaskan night.

programs.title: American Restoration
programs.desc: Rick shoots to beat the clock with a '40s high school electric scoreboard. Can this restoration score, or will Rick run out of time?

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: In Santa Ana, Dan and Laura hope for better units and better buyers. Rene tries to capitalize on warehouse sales and scoots away with a deal. Jarrod finally buys the locker he wants... and treats himself after to a spa day; while Darrell reflects on what it means to buy lockers full of antiques.

programs.title: American Pickers
programs.desc: Time has stood still on a sprawling dairy farm, and after a slow start the picking is fast and furious. Down the road, the guys pick one of the biggest barns they've ever seen.
